CustomField.description: Mirrors the parent mandate's Gateway so the transaction can be filtered without a join. List views cannot filter on a parent field, so without this every UAEDDS list view and report would be impossible or expensive. Follows the formula pattern already used on this object by DDA_Unique_Number__c, Payer_Identification__c and Escrow_IBAN_Number__c.
CustomField.label: Gateway
